title: Mine dictionary examples for your own sentences
summary: Read the example sentences attached to a headword and copy the pattern, not the topic.
attribution: Original content authored for this project.

blocks.body: A dictionary entry tells you what a word means; an example tells you what it can stand next to. When you look up a word, read any example sentence attached to it and note the frame around the word: which measure word, which complement, which particle at the end. Then keep the frame and swap the content, so a sentence about rain becomes a sentence about a bus. Write both versions side by side. That single step turns a lookup into grammar practice, and it keeps your spoken sentences close to how the language actually arranges itself.
